name: iMENA
desc: Saudi technology group running OpenSooq classifieds, SellAnyCar automotive commerce and Jeeny mobility platforms across the Middle East.
ownership: private, owner not stated (Saudi closed joint stock company iMENA Holding; investors include Sanabil Investments, FJ Labs and Saudi institutions)
capacity_detail: SAR 802M (USD 214M) capital increase in two tranches announced 17 Nov 2026, after a USD 135M pre-IPO first tranche from Sanabil Investments and others in Apr 2025: about USD 349M equity
markets: Saudi Arabia and the UAE (about 80% of revenue), plus Jordan, Oman, Kuwait and over 20 countries by users

signals.raise: SAR 802M (USD 214M) capital increase with Sanabil Investments and Saudi institutional investors (Nov 2026; https://www.wamda.com/2026/11/saudi-tech-group-imena-secures-214-million-support-regional-growth)

rationale: Consumer platforms for car buying and mobility in Saudi Arabia and UAE; Saudi Grand Prix and Abu Dhabi hospitality suit its automotive audience.
